**Non-Abelian Stokes theorem in action**

46 pp, 22 sections.

**Abstract.** In this short review main issues related to the non-Abelian Stokes theorem have been addressed. The two principal approaches to the non- Abelian Stokes theorem, operator and two variants (coherent-state and holomorphic) of the path-integral one, have been formulated in their sim- plest possible forms. A recent generalization for a knotted loop as well as a suggestion concerning higher-degree forms have been also included. Non- perturbative applications of the non-Abelian Stokes theorem, to (semi-)to- pological gauge theories, have been presented.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 1.1 Abelian Stokes theorem; 1.2 Historical remarks; 2 Non-Abelian Stokes theorem; 1.3 Contents; 2.1 Operator formalism; 2.1.1 Calculus of paths; 2.1.2 Ordering; 2.1.3 Theorem; 2.2 Path-integral formalism; 2.2.1 Coherent-state approach; 2.2.2 Holomorphic approach; 2.2.3 Measure; 2.3 Generalizations; 2.3.1 Topology; 2.3.2 Higher-dimensional forms; 3 Applications
